Example database

Source: R/io_data.R
example_io.Rd

A toy database with 3 sectors and 3 satellite accounts (E, entrant energy; I, incumbent energy; LAB, labour), consistent (f = (I - A) x), with a two-sided corridor. Used in the examples, in the tests and in the model written by lexio_template().

Usage

example_io()

Value

Object of class lexio_io.

Examples

example_io()
#> <lexio_io> 3 sectors, 3 satellite account(s): E, I, LAB | declared as Z + E | corridor: two-sided corridor 
#>   base E = D x =   6.60
#>   base I = D x =  29.00
#>   base LAB = D x = 260.00
